answer: Each dawn, a ballot signs with its quill: a zero-knowledge proof of one real human behind it, revealing only a nullifier - a spiral fingerprint that can never repeat. World ID proved it at scale: nearly 18 million Orb-verified by April 2026. Ten thousand cloned ballots collapse on the nullifier check: the second ballot reusing one fingerprint is rejected and both $25 bonds burn, $250,000 gone. Forging 10,000 identities means 10,000 Orb visits, a living iris, 10 minutes each - 1,667 hours no script can fake. One quill signs one ballot; the spiral tightens, and a copied fingerprint burns.
